title_sq: Tek Shkolla e Bashkuar, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1, Me Orientim Perfekt !!!
description_sq: Prane Shkolles se Bashkuar, ne Rrugen e Dibres, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1, me Vendndodhje Perfekte!!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 4 te nje pallati te ri me ashensor dhe te mireadministruar. Apartamenti ka siperfaqe bruto prej 100 m² dhe siperfaqe neto prej 88.3 m2. Organizimi i apartamentit fillon me korridorin qe ben shperndarjen ne sallonin e ndenjes bashke me ambientin e ngrenies dhe te gatimit, dhoma matrimoniale, dhoma e femijeve, ballkoni dhe nje tualet. Orientimi nga jug-lindja e ben te kete drite gjate pjeses me te madhe te dites. Shitesi ka investuar cdo gje nga fillimi, duke filluar nga sistemi elektrik, sistemi hidraulik, dyer, dritare, parket, tualeti e deri tek ndricimi led. Mobiljet dhe pajisjet elektroshtepiaket jane te markave me te mira ne treg. Zona ofron shume facilitete duke nisur nga lokacioni perfekt, afersia me Qendren dhe me institucionet dhe per kete arsye eshte nje mundesi shume e mire si per te jetuar ashtu edhe per investim. Pronari disponon dhe nje post parkimi me cmim extra 22,000 euro.
title_en: Near the United School, Super Apartment 2+1 for sale, with perfect orientation!!!
description_en: Near the United School, on Dibra Street, Super Apartment 2+1 for sale, with a perfect location!!! The apartment is located on the 4th floor of a new, well-managed building with an elevator. The apartment has a gross area of ​​100 m² and a net area of ​​88.3 m2. The organization of the apartment begins with the corridor that divides the living room with the dining and cooking area, matrimonial room, children's room, balcony and a toilet. Orientation from the south-east makes it light during most of the day. The seller has invested everything from the beginning, starting from the electrical system, hydraulic system, doors, windows, parquet, toilet and up to the LED lighting. Furniture and household appliances are of the best brands in the market. The area offers many facilities, starting from the perfect location, the proximity to the Center and the institutions, and for this reason it is a very good opportunity both for living and for investment. The owner also has a parking post with an extra price of 22,000 euros.
